title: A transcriptome-based risk model in sepsis enables prognostic prediction and drug repositioning.

models.verbatim_formula: risk score = −0.0678 ∗ ABLIM1 + 0.0825 ∗ HPGD + 0.1607 ∗ LY96 + 0.1463 ∗ OLAH
models.cutoff: median risk score within each cohort
models.reported_performance: 28-day mortality AUC: E-MTAB-5273 discovery 0.70; E-MTAB-4451 0.67; GSE63042 (E-GEOD-63042) 0.61; GSE65682 (E-GEOD-65682) 0.62; diagnosis AUC 0.99 in E-MTAB-5273
models.source_location: Results 'Identification of prognostic genes and development of a risk score' (formula) + Figure 1F + Figure 2

notes: LASSO (logistic, lambda ~0.03) on 20 genes from univariate logistic regression in discovery set E-MTAB-5273. GSE28750, GSE63042, GSE65682 are referred to by their ArrayExpress mirrors E-GEOD-28750/63042/65682 (text also writes 'E-MTAB-65682'). E-MTAB-7581 (VANISH) used for treatment-interaction analysis. Paper reports GSE63042 deaths 10/53 in HR vs 18/53 in LR (opposite to claim; p=0.78) - as printed. Exact cohort n not in main text (Table S1 in supplement). 'This paper does not report original code.'
